Disclosure to Promote the Right To Information 

Whereas the Parliament of India has set out to provide a practical regime of right to 
information for citizens to secure access to information under the control of public authorities, 
in order to promote transparency and accountability in the working of every public authority, 
and whereas the attached publication of the Bureau of Indian Standards is of particular interest 
to the public, particularly disadvantaged communities and those engaged in the pursuit of 
education and knowledge, the attached public safety standard is made available to promote the 
timely dissemination of this information in an accurate manner to the public.

SPECIFICATION FOR 
PERFORATOR, SIMPSON'S PATTERN 



1. Scope — Prescribes dimensions and other requirements for Simpson's pattern perforator used 
in obstetrics. 

2. Shape and Dimensions — As shown in Fig. 1.

18:7480-1974 

2.1 Joint— Screvi recessed type as given in 6 of Section 2 of IS : 3642-1966 ' general requlitements 
for surgical instruments '. jf 

3. Material — Stainless steel conforming to Designation 30Cr13 of IS: 6603*1972 'Specification 
for stainless steel bars and flats '. 

4. Workmanship and Finish 

4.1 The perforator shall be free from scales, burrs, pits and other defects. 

4.2 The perforator shall be symmetrical and well-balanced. 

4.3 All edges except the cutting edge shall be rounded. 

4.4 The arms of the perforator shall move easily and freely at the joints but there shall be no undue 
side-play at the joints. When the locking device is in operation and the arms pressed, there shall 
be no separation of the blades. 

4.5 The perforator shall be polished bright and passivated. 

5. Heat Treatment— The perforator shall be hardened and tempered to give a hardness of 450 to 
500 HV. 

6. Test 

6.1 Corrosion Resistance Test — Scrub the sample with soap and warm water, rinse in hot water and 
then dip in 95 percent ethyl alcohol. Dry the sample. Immerse in copper sulphate solution at room 
temperature for 6 minutes and then wash off with fresh water or wet cotton wool. Composition of 
the solution shall be as follows: 

Copper sulphate ( CUSO4.5H2O ) 4*0 g 

Sulphuric acid ( H2SO4 ) ( sp gr 1*84 ) 10*0 g 

Distilled water [ see IS : 1070-1960 Specification 90*0 ml 

for water, distilled quality ( revised)] 

No red stains or spots on the sample shall be allowed but dulling of polished surface may be 
permitted. 

6.2 The perforator shall cleanly perforate a 4 mm thick hardboard sheet. 

7. IMarking —The perforator shall be marked with the following: 

a) Manufacturer's name, initials or recognized trade-mark; and 

b) The words ' Stainless Steel *. 

7.1 ISI Certification /VfarA/ng — Details available with the Indian Standards Institution. 

8. Packing — The perforator shall be wrapped in moisture-proof paper or in polyethylene bag and 
then packed in a carton.
